Requirement: The system shall generate an email from user-provided bullet points. Description: User-entered points are sent to the generation service and a subject and body are returned. Acceptance Criteria: Valid points produce a non-empty subject and body. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall support Professional Friendly and Formal email tones. Description: The selected tone is passed to Gemini and used when generating the email. Acceptance Criteria: Professional, Friendly, and Formal selections are supported. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall reject email-generation requests without bullet points. Description: An empty points field must return a controlled validation error. Acceptance Criteria: Missing bullet points return HTTP 400 with an explanatory message. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall use Google Gemini to generate email content. Description: The backend shall attempt configured Gemini models to produce the email. Acceptance Criteria: A configured Gemini service can generate subject and body content. Priority: High

Requirement: The AI generation service shall return subject and body fields. Description: The generated response is converted into a structured subject/body result. Acceptance Criteria: Successful generation returns non-empty subject and body fields. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall report an error when GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured. Description: Generation and grammar verification require a valid Gemini API key. Acceptance Criteria: Missing or placeholder API key produces a controlled configuration error. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall verify grammar spelling punctuation clarity and tone of an email. Description: The verify endpoint sends the subject and body to the grammar service. Acceptance Criteria: Verification returns isCorrect and suggestions. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall reject grammar verification when both subject and body are empty. Description: At least one of subject or body must be provided. Acceptance Criteria: Empty subject and body return HTTP 400. Priority: High

Requirement: The grammar service shall return an isCorrect flag and suggestions list. Description: The AI response is normalized into the expected structured result. Acceptance Criteria: Response contains boolean isCorrect and list suggestions. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall send generated emails through Gmail SMTP. Description: The email service shall connect to smtp.gmail.com on port 587 using STARTTLS. Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials and message data result in successful SMTP delivery. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall require sender email Gmail App Password and receiver email before sending. Description: Missing credentials must prevent an SMTP attempt. Acceptance Criteria: Missing sender password or receiver returns HTTP 400. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall require a non-empty subject and body before sending. Description: Empty generated content must not be sent. Acceptance Criteria: Missing subject or body returns HTTP 400. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall return controlled errors for SMTP authentication connection and recipient failures. Description: SMTP exceptions are converted to user-readable runtime errors. Acceptance Criteria: Authentication connection and recipient failures return controlled error responses. Priority: High

Requirement: The frontend shall allow the generated subject and body to be edited before sending. Description: Generated content is displayed in editable fields. Acceptance Criteria: User can modify subject and body before send. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The frontend shall support copying generated email content and downloading it as TXT. Description: Copy combines subject/body and download saves a text file. Acceptance Criteria: Copy and TXT download work when generated content exists. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The frontend shall support dark/light theme switching and form reset. Description: Theme persists through local storage and reset clears form and generated state. Acceptance Criteria: Theme toggles and reset clears generated content and inputs. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall allow users to upload between 1 and 10 PDF files. Description: Users can select one or multiple PDF documents for indexing. Acceptance Criteria: 1-10 PDF files are accepted and more than 10 are rejected. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall accept only PDF files for document indexing. Description: Non-PDF file types shall be rejected. Acceptance Criteria: DOCX TXT ZIP image and other non-PDF files return a controlled validation error. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall reject PDF files larger than 25 MB. Description: Each uploaded PDF is checked against the configured maximum size. Acceptance Criteria: A PDF above 25 MB is rejected with a clear error. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall extract text from uploaded PDFs using PyMuPDF. Description: Text is extracted page by page with filename and page metadata. Acceptance Criteria: Readable page text is extracted and associated with its source page. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall split extracted PDF text into chunks using configured chunk size and overlap. Description: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter creates chunks while preserving source metadata. Acceptance Criteria: Chunks are created with 500 character size and 100 character overlap by default. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall generate dense embeddings for extracted text chunks. Description: Sentence Transformers generates embeddings using all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Acceptance Criteria: Every valid text chunk can be converted into an embedding. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall store document embeddings in a local FAISS vector index. Description: FAISS stores embeddings and associated chunk metadata. Acceptance Criteria: Indexed chunks can be persisted and retrieved from the vector store. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall persist the FAISS index and document metadata to disk. Description: Vector index and metadata are saved under the configured vector store directory. Acceptance Criteria: Existing vector store data is loaded when the backend starts. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall clear the existing vector store when a new upload batch is indexed. Description: A new batch replaces the previous indexed document state. Acceptance Criteria: Existing vectors are cleared before the new batch is stored. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall accept a non-empty user question through the chat API. Description: Questions are received through POST /chat. Acceptance Criteria: A valid question is processed and a ChatResponse is returned. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall retrieve the top 5 relevant document chunks for a question. Description: The question is embedded and compared against the FAISS index. Acceptance Criteria: At most five relevant chunks are retrieved for answering. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall generate answers only from uploaded document context. Description: Gemini receives a strict prompt requiring answers from retrieved context only. Acceptance Criteria: The system does not intentionally invent information outside the supplied context. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall return source PDF filename and page number for retrieved answers. Description: Unique filename/page pairs are returned as source references. Acceptance Criteria: Successful grounded answers include source references. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall return a standard response when information is unavailable in uploaded documents. Description: The configured fallback response indicates that the information could not be found. Acceptance Criteria: Unavailable information returns the specified fallback response and no sources. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall use Google Gemini to generate document-grounded answers. Description: Gemini is invoked with the constructed RAG prompt. Acceptance Criteria: Configured Gemini service returns an answer or controlled fallback. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall expose a health endpoint and display backend availability in the Angular frontend. Description: The frontend polls /health and updates the system status indicator. Acceptance Criteria: Running backend shows System Ready and unavailable backend shows Connecting. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall expose a health endpoint. Description: The backend shall provide a basic service health response. Acceptance Criteria: GET / returns status healthy with HTTP 200. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall accept a meeting transcript as text. Description: Users can paste transcript text into the frontend. Acceptance Criteria: A non-empty transcript can be submitted to /api/generate. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall allow users to upload TXT transcript files. Description: TXT files shall be read and returned as transcript text. Acceptance Criteria: A valid .txt upload returns the file contents. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall reject transcript uploads that are not TXT files. Description: Only .txt transcript files are accepted. Acceptance Criteria: Non-TXT files return HTTP 400 with a controlled validation message. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall accept supported audio and video meeting recordings. Description: Supported formats include MP4 WEBM MKV MOV MP3 WAV M4A OGG and FLAC. Acceptance Criteria: Supported media extensions are accepted by the transcription workflow. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall limit media uploads to 500 MB for transcription. Description: Large media files shall be rejected before processing. Acceptance Criteria: Files above 500 MB are rejected. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall extract audio from supported video recordings. Description: FFmpeg shall convert video input into an MP3 audio stream. Acceptance Criteria: A supported video can be converted to temporary audio for transcription. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall transcribe meeting audio using Google Gemini. Description: Gemini processes uploaded audio and returns transcript entries. Acceptance Criteria: Transcription returns a JSON list of speaker timestamp and text entries. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall identify speakers in transcript entries. Description: Names should be used when identifiable and Speaker N when names are unclear. Acceptance Criteria: Every transcript entry contains a speaker field. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall provide approximate timestamps for transcript segments. Description: Each transcript entry shall contain a timestamp. Acceptance Criteria: Every transcript entry contains a timestamp such as 00:00:05. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall generate structured meeting minutes from a transcript. Description: Gemini generates summary decisions action items owners deadlines and conversation transcript. Acceptance Criteria: Valid transcript input returns the defined MeetingMinutes JSON structure. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall extract action items with owner deadline priority and status. Description: Action items shall contain all five defined fields. Acceptance Criteria: Each action item contains task owner deadline priority and status. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall identify meeting participants and their responsibilities. Description: Owners are returned as structured owner/responsibility pairs. Acceptance Criteria: The generated minutes contain an owners array. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall extract task deadlines from meeting content. Description: Missing deadlines shall be represented as Not Mentioned. Acceptance Criteria: Each deadline entry contains task and deadline. Priority: Medium

Requirement: The system shall export generated meeting minutes and transcripts to DOCX and PDF formats. Description: Users can download formatted meeting documents. Acceptance Criteria: DOCX and PDF endpoints return downloadable files for valid data. Priority: High

Requirement: The system shall instruct Gemini to extract only factual information from the supplied transcript. Description: The AI should not invent meeting information. Acceptance Criteria: Generated content is based on transcript facts and uses Not Mentioned for absent deadlines. Priority: High

Recommended Action: Add consistent sender validation. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-059

Defect: Missing App Password reaches SMTP Component: SMTP Validation Description: SMTP send can be attempted without an App Password. Observed Behavior: SMTP authentication fails after request reaches service. Expected Behavior: Missing App Password should be rejected before SMTP connection. Probable Root Cause: Validation happens too late. Recommended Action: Validate credentials before SMTP connection. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-059

Defect: Missing receiver reaches SMTP Component: SMTP Validation Description: Receiver validation can occur after send request begins. Observed Behavior: SMTP process is attempted with incomplete recipient data. Expected Behavior: Receiver should be required before SMTP processing. Probable Root Cause: Request validation is incomplete. Recommended Action: Validate receiver before constructing SMTP message. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-059

Defect: Empty subject can be sent Component: Message Validation Description: Email send request can contain an empty subject. Observed Behavior: SMTP processing receives incomplete message content. Expected Behavior: Subject should be required before sending. Probable Root Cause: Message validation is incomplete. Recommended Action: Reject empty subject before SMTP processing. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-060

Defect: Empty body can be sent Component: Message Validation Description: Email send request can contain an empty body. Observed Behavior: SMTP processing receives incomplete message content. Expected Behavior: Body should be required before sending. Probable Root Cause: Message validation is incomplete. Recommended Action: Reject empty body before SMTP processing. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-060

Defect: SMTP authentication failure exposed poorly Component: SMTP Error Handling Description: Gmail authentication failures may not produce sufficiently actionable messages. Observed Behavior: User receives generic send failure. Expected Behavior: Authentication errors should be clearly identified without exposing secrets. Probable Root Cause: Exception mapping is too generic. Recommended Action: Map SMTP authentication errors to a safe user-facing error. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-061

Defect: SMTP connection failure Component: SMTP Error Handling Description: Gmail SMTP connection failures interrupt sending. Observed Behavior: Send request fails unexpectedly. Expected Behavior: Connection failures should return controlled errors. Probable Root Cause: Socket/SMTP exceptions are not consistently mapped. Recommended Action: Handle connection exceptions explicitly. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-061

Defect: Recipient rejection not clearly handled Component: SMTP Error Handling Description: SMTP recipient rejection may be returned as a generic error. Observed Behavior: User cannot determine that recipient was rejected. Expected Behavior: Recipient failures should have controlled error handling. Probable Root Cause: SMTP recipient exceptions are not classified. Recommended Action: Map recipient rejection separately. Severity: High Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-061

Defect: Edited subject not preserved Component: Email Editing Description: User edits to generated subject may be lost before sending. Observed Behavior: Original generated subject is sent instead of edited value. Expected Behavior: Edited subject should be used for sending. Probable Root Cause: Frontend state synchronization is incomplete. Recommended Action: Bind edited subject directly to send payload. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-062

Defect: Edited body not preserved Component: Email Editing Description: User edits to generated body may be lost before sending. Observed Behavior: Original body is sent instead of edited value. Expected Behavior: Edited body should be used for sending. Probable Root Cause: Frontend state synchronization is incomplete. Recommended Action: Bind edited body directly to send payload. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-062

Defect: Copy action with no content Component: Utility Functions Description: Copy can be invoked before an email is generated. Observed Behavior: Clipboard operation has no useful content. Expected Behavior: User should receive a clear no-content message. Probable Root Cause: Empty-state handling is incomplete. Recommended Action: Guard copy action when generated content is absent. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-063

Defect: Download action with no content Component: Utility Functions Description: Download can be invoked before an email is generated. Observed Behavior: Empty or meaningless TXT file may be created. Expected Behavior: Download should be blocked when no email exists. Probable Root Cause: Empty-state handling is incomplete. Recommended Action: Guard download action when content is absent. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-063

Defect: Theme state not restored Component: Theme and Reset Description: Selected theme may not persist across application reload. Observed Behavior: Application returns to default theme. Expected Behavior: Selected theme should be restored from local storage. Probable Root Cause: Theme persistence handling is incomplete. Recommended Action: Persist and restore theme consistently. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-064

Defect: Reset leaves generated state Component: Theme and Reset Description: Reset may clear input fields while leaving generated state. Observed Behavior: Old generated email remains visible or usable. Expected Behavior: Reset should clear all form and generated state. Probable Root Cause: Reset handling does not clear every state variable. Recommended Action: Clear generated subject body verification state and inputs. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-064

Defect: End-to-end failure after successful generation Component: Email Workflow Description: Generated email can be successfully created but fail during later verification or send without clear state handling. Observed Behavior: User must recover manually from intermediate failure. Expected Behavior: Each workflow stage should expose a controlled result and preserve editable content. Probable Root Cause: Frontend workflow error state handling is incomplete. Recommended Action: Add consistent stage-level error handling and state preservation. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-049;REQ-055;REQ-058

Defect: Email workflow reports success incorrectly Component: Email Workflow Description: Failed downstream operations may leave the UI in a success state. Observed Behavior: User sees successful workflow despite failed send or verification. Expected Behavior: UI should report actual operation status. Probable Root Cause: Success state is not synchronized with backend response. Recommended Action: Synchronize UI status with every API result. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-055;REQ-058

Defect: Upload file count validation Component: Upload Description: More than ten files must be rejected. Observed Behavior: Oversized file batches can reach validation. Expected Behavior: More than 10 files should always return HTTP 400. Probable Root Cause: Validation depends on request file list handling. Recommended Action: Add explicit count validation before processing. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-065

Defect: Non-PDF rejection Component: Upload Description: Only PDF files should be accepted. Observed Behavior: Non-PDF content may be submitted through multipart requests. Expected Behavior: Non-PDF extensions should be rejected consistently. Probable Root Cause: Extension validation is the primary gate. Recommended Action: Strengthen MIME and extension validation. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-066

Defect: Oversized PDF rejection Component: Upload Description: Files over 25 MB must be rejected. Observed Behavior: Large content can consume resources before downstream processing. Expected Behavior: Files over 25 MB should fail immediately. Probable Root Cause: Size is checked after file read. Recommended Action: Add streaming or earlier size protection where practical. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-067

Defect: Unreadable PDF handling Component: PDF Extraction Description: PDFs without readable text are skipped. Observed Behavior: User may receive only a generic no-text error. Expected Behavior: Skipped files should be clearly reported. Probable Root Cause: Unreadable pages are filtered silently until batch result. Recommended Action: Return per-file processing feedback. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-068

Defect: PDF resource cleanup Component: PDF Extraction Description: PDF resources should always be closed. Observed Behavior: Exception during page extraction can interrupt normal close flow. Expected Behavior: PDF resources should be closed even on errors. Probable Root Cause: Close occurs after normal iteration. Recommended Action: Use guaranteed resource cleanup. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-068

Defect: Empty chunk handling Component: Chunking Description: Chunk creation should not produce empty chunks. Observed Behavior: Whitespace chunks could be passed downstream. Expected Behavior: Only meaningful chunks should be stored. Probable Root Cause: Filtering occurs after splitter output. Recommended Action: Add explicit empty-chunk safeguards. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-069

Defect: Embedding model startup cost Component: Embeddings Description: Sentence Transformer initialization can be expensive. Observed Behavior: Backend startup can be slow. Expected Behavior: Model initialization should be managed efficiently. Probable Root Cause: Model loads when service is instantiated. Recommended Action: Consider lazy loading or controlled lifecycle management. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-070

Defect: Embedding failure handling Component: Embeddings Description: Embedding generation failures should return controlled errors. Observed Behavior: Unexpected model errors can propagate from upload flow. Expected Behavior: Embedding failures should produce a safe API error. Probable Root Cause: No explicit exception mapping exists around embedding generation. Recommended Action: Add controlled embedding exception handling. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-070

Defect: FAISS persistence failure Component: Vector Storage Description: Vector persistence failures can interrupt indexing. Observed Behavior: Save failures can propagate without user-friendly context. Expected Behavior: Persistence failures should return controlled indexing errors. Probable Root Cause: save_vector_store has limited error mapping. Recommended Action: Add persistence exception handling. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-071;REQ-072

Defect: Vector metadata mismatch Component: Vector Storage Description: FAISS index and metadata must remain aligned. Observed Behavior: Corrupted or partially saved data can produce invalid metadata lookups. Expected Behavior: Index entries should always correspond to metadata entries. Probable Root Cause: Persistence is split across two files. Recommended Action: Use atomic persistence or integrity validation. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-071;REQ-072

Defect: New upload clears previous knowledge Component: Vector Reset Description: Every new batch replaces the current vector store. Observed Behavior: Users may expect uploaded documents to accumulate. Expected Behavior: New batch behavior should be explicitly communicated. Probable Root Cause: upload endpoint intentionally calls vector_service.clear(). Recommended Action: Expose replacement behavior clearly in UI. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-073

Defect: Empty question whitespace handling Component: Chat Validation Description: Question schema requires minimum length but whitespace can still pass. Observed Behavior: Whitespace question may reach RAG processing. Expected Behavior: Whitespace-only questions should be rejected. Probable Root Cause: Pydantic min_length does not trim whitespace. Recommended Action: Add normalized question validation. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-074

Defect: Top five retrieval relevance Component: Semantic Retrieval Description: Similarity search always uses top five nearest vectors. Observed Behavior: Irrelevant chunks can be included even when similarity is weak. Expected Behavior: Retrieval should optionally apply a relevance threshold. Probable Root Cause: FAISS search uses fixed top_k without distance threshold. Recommended Action: Add configurable similarity threshold. Severity: High Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-075

Defect: Gemini unavailable response Component: AI Integration Description: Missing Gemini configuration returns a generic answer string. Observed Behavior: User receives limited explanation of the failure. Expected Behavior: Configuration failure should be distinguishable from no-answer response. Probable Root Cause: Gemini service uses a generic fallback string. Recommended Action: Return structured error state where appropriate. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-079

Defect: Gemini fallback model inconsistency Component: AI Integration Description: Fallback model naming may not match available deployed models. Observed Behavior: Fallback may fail after primary model failure. Expected Behavior: Fallback model should be configurable and verified. Probable Root Cause: Fallback model is hard-coded. Recommended Action: Move model names into configuration. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-079

Defect: Hallucination protection depends on prompt Component: Grounded Answering Description: Grounding is enforced through prompt instructions. Observed Behavior: A model could still produce unsupported content. Expected Behavior: Unsupported claims should be validated where possible. Probable Root Cause: No post-generation factual validation exists. Recommended Action: Add citation/grounding checks or retrieval confidence controls. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-076

Defect: No-answer source behavior Component: No Answer Handling Description: No-answer response intentionally returns no sources. Observed Behavior: User may not know why sources are absent. Expected Behavior: No-answer state should be clearly represented in UI. Probable Root Cause: RAG returns empty sources by design. Recommended Action: Display an explicit no-source explanation. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-078

Defect: Duplicate source removal Component: Source Citation Description: Multiple chunks from one page are deduplicated. Observed Behavior: Source list may still differ when metadata is inconsistent. Expected Behavior: Each unique filename/page pair should appear once. Probable Root Cause: Deduplication relies on exact metadata values. Recommended Action: Normalize filenames before deduplication. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-077

Defect: Missing citation enforcement Component: Source Citation Description: Gemini is instructed to cite sources but output is not parsed for citation compliance. Observed Behavior: Answer can omit explicit citation text while API sources exist. Expected Behavior: Answer should visibly cite source filename and page when required. Probable Root Cause: Prompt instruction is not programmatically verified. Recommended Action: Validate citation presence before returning answer. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-077

Defect: Gemini exception masking Component: AI Integration Description: All Gemini exceptions become the same fallback string. Observed Behavior: Different service failures cannot be diagnosed by API consumers. Expected Behavior: Controlled error categories should be exposed safely. Probable Root Cause: Broad exception handling masks error type. Recommended Action: Introduce structured error handling and logging. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-079

Defect: CORS overly permissive Component: CORS Description: Backend allows all origins and credentials. Observed Behavior: Any origin can interact with the API. Expected Behavior: Production deployment should restrict allowed origins. Probable Root Cause: allow_origins is set to wildcard. Recommended Action: Configure explicit frontend origin allowlist. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-080

Defect: Frontend API URL hard-coded Component: Frontend Description: Frontend directly uses localhost:8000. Observed Behavior: Deployment to another host requires source modification. Expected Behavior: API base URL should be configurable. Probable Root Cause: FaqService contains hard-coded URL. Recommended Action: Use Angular environment configuration. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-080

Defect: Health polling interval cleanup Component: Frontend Description: Header creates a recurring interval without cleanup. Observed Behavior: Component destruction can leave the timer running. Expected Behavior: Polling timer should be cleaned up when component is destroyed. Probable Root Cause: setInterval is not cleared. Recommended Action: Implement interval cleanup with lifecycle management. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-080

Defect: Selected files can exceed UI limit Component: Frontend Upload Description: UI combines selected files without explicitly enforcing ten-file maximum locally. Observed Behavior: More than ten selected files can appear before backend rejection. Expected Behavior: Frontend should enforce the same file count limit. Probable Root Cause: addFiles simply concatenates files. Recommended Action: Validate count in the state service/component. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-065

Defect: Upload state error handling Component: Frontend Upload Description: Backend upload errors should reset upload progress state. Observed Behavior: Failed upload may leave UI state inconsistent. Expected Behavior: Failure should clear isUploading and display error. Probable Root Cause: Exact state reset depends on component error callback. Recommended Action: Centralize upload state transitions. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-065

Defect: Chat loading state error handling Component: Frontend Chat Description: Question errors should always reset asking state. Observed Behavior: A failed request could leave the spinner active. Expected Behavior: isAsking should always return false after errors. Probable Root Cause: Error callback implementation must reset state. Recommended Action: Use finalize for request state cleanup. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-074

Defect: Chat history memory growth Component: Frontend Chat Description: Chat messages are retained indefinitely until manually cleared. Observed Behavior: Long sessions can grow browser memory usage. Expected Behavior: History should have an optional limit or pagination. Probable Root Cause: State service prepends messages without a limit. Recommended Action: Add configurable history size limit. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-074

Defect: Vector store corruption recovery Component: Vector Storage Description: Corrupt saved index files can cause load failures. Observed Behavior: System resets the index but loses previous knowledge without notification. Expected Behavior: Recovery should notify operators or users. Probable Root Cause: load_vector_store resets silently after logging an error. Recommended Action: Expose recovery state and rebuild guidance. Severity: High Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-072

Defect: End-to-end error visibility Component: Frontend Integration Description: Backend failures should be shown clearly in the frontend. Observed Behavior: Generic errors can be difficult for users to diagnose. Expected Behavior: Upload and chat errors should display actionable messages. Probable Root Cause: Frontend state uses generic error strings depending on callback. Recommended Action: Standardize API error presentation. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-080

Defect: Concurrent upload race Component: Upload Description: Concurrent indexing requests can modify the same vector store. Observed Behavior: One upload may clear another upload's index state. Expected Behavior: Only one indexing batch should update the vector store at a time. Probable Root Cause: Vector service has no locking mechanism. Recommended Action: Add upload/index synchronization. Severity: High Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-073

Defect: Unsupported media extension reaches backend Component: Media Upload Description: Backend transcription endpoint does not explicitly validate the extension before saving. Observed Behavior: Unsupported media can reach transcription service. Expected Behavior: Unsupported extensions should be rejected before processing. Probable Root Cause: routes.py delegates extension handling to transcription service without an explicit allowlist check. Recommended Action: Add backend extension validation using supported media extensions. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-085

Defect: Backend media size validation missing Component: Media Upload Description: MAX_FILE_BYTES is defined but not enforced in transcribe_media. Observed Behavior: A file over 500 MB may be processed if Flask accepts it. Expected Behavior: Files above 500 MB should be rejected server-side. Probable Root Cause: Configured constant is unused for validation. Recommended Action: Validate file size before processing. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-086

Defect: Video filename can contain unsafe path characters Component: Media Upload Description: Uploaded media filename is concatenated directly into saved path. Observed Behavior: Unexpected path characters may affect temporary storage. Expected Behavior: Saved filenames should be safely sanitized. Probable Root Cause: secure_filename is used for TXT upload but not media upload. Recommended Action: Use secure_filename for media uploads. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-085

Defect: Temporary media cleanup after exception Component: Media Cleanup Description: Temporary media cleanup depends on saved_path being present and normal flow. Observed Behavior: Some generated temporary artifacts can remain after failures. Expected Behavior: All temporary files should be cleaned after processing. Probable Root Cause: Cleanup does not comprehensively track generated paths. Recommended Action: Track and clean all temporary artifacts in finally. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-087

Defect: FFmpeg output collision Component: Audio Extraction Description: Temporary audio filename is derived from input path. Observed Behavior: Repeated operations can potentially target the same derived filename. Expected Behavior: Temporary audio filenames should be unique. Probable Root Cause: Output path uses input basename plus _audio.mp3. Recommended Action: Generate a unique temporary audio path. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-087

Defect: FFmpeg timeout fixed at five minutes Component: Audio Extraction Description: Large recordings may need more than five minutes for audio extraction. Observed Behavior: Valid long recordings can fail due to timeout. Expected Behavior: Timeout should be configurable based on media size or environment. Probable Root Cause: Timeout is hard-coded to 300 seconds. Recommended Action: Make timeout configurable. Severity: Low Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-087

Defect: Gemini model name hard-coded Component: AI Transcription Description: Gemini model is hard-coded to gemini-3.7-flash. Observed Behavior: Model changes require code changes. Expected Behavior: Model selection should be configuration-driven. Probable Root Cause: Model identifier is embedded in service code. Recommended Action: Move model name to environment configuration. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-088

Defect: Mock fallback masks transcription failure Component: AI Transcription Description: Transcription exceptions return mock meeting entries. Observed Behavior: Users may receive synthetic content instead of knowing transcription failed. Expected Behavior: Production failures should be reported clearly rather than silently replaced. Probable Root Cause: Broad exception handling falls back to fixed mock data. Recommended Action: Return controlled error and make fallback configurable for development only. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-088

Defect: Gemini API failure masks minutes failure Component: Minutes Generation Description: Gemini generation failure returns hard-coded mock minutes. Observed Behavior: Generated minutes may not reflect supplied transcript. Expected Behavior: The system should report generation failure when AI is unavailable. Probable Root Cause: gemini_service.py intentionally falls back to mock_json. Recommended Action: Disable mock fallback in production. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-091;REQ-096

Defect: Missing API key only partially validated Component: AI Configuration Description: Gemini configuration validation occurs inside service methods. Observed Behavior: Frontend may start processing before configuration failure becomes visible. Expected Behavior: Configuration should be validated clearly at startup or request entry. Probable Root Cause: API key check is distributed across services. Recommended Action: Add centralized configuration validation. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-088;REQ-091

Defect: Transcript JSON shape not fully validated Component: Transcription Description: Parsed Gemini JSON is checked only for list type. Observed Behavior: Entries missing speaker timestamp or text may reach frontend. Expected Behavior: Every transcript entry should satisfy the expected schema. Probable Root Cause: No per-entry schema validation exists. Recommended Action: Validate each entry before returning response. Severity: High Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-089;REQ-090

Defect: Invalid Gemini JSON handling exposes raw content Component: Transcription Description: JSON parse failure includes a raw response prefix in exception. Observed Behavior: Provider output may be exposed to API consumers. Expected Behavior: Errors should contain safe diagnostic information. Probable Root Cause: ValueError includes response text. Recommended Action: Return sanitized parse errors and log raw details server-side. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-088

Defect: Generated minutes schema not validated Component: Minutes Generation Description: Gemini response is parsed directly into a dictionary. Observed Behavior: Missing sections can reach frontend and exports. Expected Behavior: Generated minutes should be validated against MeetingMinutes schema. Probable Root Cause: No backend schema validation exists. Recommended Action: Add Pydantic or equivalent response validation. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-091

Defect: Priority inferred by AI Component: Minutes Generation Description: Priority is inferred when unclear. Observed Behavior: Inferred priority may not match actual project expectations. Expected Behavior: Inference should be clearly labeled or constrained. Probable Root Cause: Prompt explicitly asks model to infer priority. Recommended Action: Add confidence/unknown option or document inference behavior. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-092

Defect: Status always defaults Pending Component: Minutes Generation Description: Prompt specifies Pending unless stated otherwise. Observed Behavior: Completed tasks can be incorrectly marked pending when transcript wording is ambiguous. Expected Behavior: Status should reflect explicit completion statements reliably. Probable Root Cause: Prompt-based extraction is not post-validated. Recommended Action: Add status normalization rules. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-092

Defect: Deadline missing behavior depends on prompt Component: Minutes Generation Description: Not Mentioned is instructed but not schema-enforced. Observed Behavior: Unexpected empty deadline values may appear. Expected Behavior: Missing deadlines should always normalize to Not Mentioned. Probable Root Cause: No response validation exists. Recommended Action: Normalize missing deadlines after generation. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-094

Defect: Export DOCX accepts incomplete minutes Component: Document Export Description: Export endpoint checks only whether request JSON exists. Observed Behavior: Malformed minutes can create incomplete documents. Expected Behavior: Required minutes sections should be validated before export. Probable Root Cause: No input schema validation. Recommended Action: Validate export payload. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: Export PDF accepts incomplete minutes Component: Document Export Description: PDF export does not validate section structure. Observed Behavior: Incomplete data can generate incomplete PDF. Expected Behavior: Export should reject invalid minutes payloads. Probable Root Cause: No payload schema validation. Recommended Action: Validate minutes before PDF generation. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: Transcript PDF text truncation Component: Transcript Export Description: PDF transcript export truncates spoken text to 120 characters. Observed Behavior: Long spoken segments are cut off in exported PDF. Expected Behavior: Export should preserve full transcript text with wrapping. Probable Root Cause: create_transcript_pdf slices text to 120 characters. Recommended Action: Use multi-cell wrapping instead of truncation. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: PDF table rows do not wrap Component: Document Export Description: PDF table cells use single-line cells for long values. Observed Behavior: Long action items or responsibilities can be clipped. Expected Behavior: Long content should wrap within table cells. Probable Root Cause: FPDF cell is used instead of multi_cell. Recommended Action: Implement wrapped table rows. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: PDF encoding replacement Component: Document Export Description: PDF safe() converts text to latin-1 with replacement. Observed Behavior: Unicode meeting text can lose characters. Expected Behavior: PDF should preserve common Unicode text. Probable Root Cause: Helvetica latin-1 encoding is used. Recommended Action: Use a Unicode-capable PDF font. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: Transcript DOCX PDF export button mismatch Component: Frontend Export Description: PDF download method exists but UI currently emphasizes DOCX only. Observed Behavior: Users may not discover transcript PDF export. Expected Behavior: Both available exports should be visibly accessible. Probable Root Cause: Template exposes only DOCX button in shown export controls. Recommended Action: Add visible PDF export button. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: Minutes PDF button not visible Component: Frontend Export Description: Minutes component shown exposes DOCX download only. Observed Behavior: Users cannot directly access PDF export from that component. Expected Behavior: PDF export should have a visible UI control. Probable Root Cause: downloadPdf is not implemented in Minutes component. Recommended Action: Add PDF download action. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: Hard-coded frontend API URL Component: Frontend Integration Description: Angular service points directly to 127.0.0.1:5000/api. Observed Behavior: Deployment to other environments requires source modification. Expected Behavior: API URL should be environment-configurable. Probable Root Cause: apiUrl is hard-coded. Recommended Action: Use Angular environment configuration. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-081;REQ-095

Defect: CORS allows all origins Component: Security Description: Backend enables unrestricted Flask CORS. Observed Behavior: Any origin can call the API. Expected Behavior: Production should restrict allowed frontend origins. Probable Root Cause: CORS(app) uses default permissive configuration. Recommended Action: Configure explicit allowed origins. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-081

Defect: Frontend loading state not cleared on successful generation Component: Frontend UX Description: Transcript generate component emits minutes but does not emit loading false in success callback. Observed Behavior: Parent may remain in loading state depending on parent handling. Expected Behavior: Loading should always be cleared after completion. Probable Root Cause: loading false is only emitted on error in transcript.ts. Recommended Action: Emit loading false in success callback. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-091

Defect: Selected TXT file state not reset Component: Frontend Transcript Description: Uploading a new TXT file may retain previous input control state. Observed Behavior: Repeated uploads can behave inconsistently in browser UI. Expected Behavior: File input should reset after successful processing if necessary. Probable Root Cause: Input element is not explicitly reset. Recommended Action: Reset file control after upload. Severity: Low Priority: Low Related Requirement: REQ-083

Defect: Media error fallback returns success HTTP status Component: Frontend Integration Description: Transcription exception handler returns mock entries with HTTP 200. Observed Behavior: Frontend treats failed transcription as successful. Expected Behavior: Real failures should return an error status. Probable Root Cause: Broad exception handler converts failure into success response. Recommended Action: Return HTTP 4xx/5xx for production failures. Severity: High Priority: High Related Requirement: REQ-088

Defect: Generated files accumulate indefinitely Component: Storage Description: Generated DOCX/PDF files are saved without cleanup policy. Observed Behavior: generated_docs can grow over time. Expected Behavior: Generated files should have retention or cleanup policy. Probable Root Cause: Files are created with UUID names and never removed. Recommended Action: Implement retention cleanup. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-095

Defect: No transcript length limit Component: Input Validation Description: Very large pasted transcripts can be sent directly to Gemini. Observed Behavior: Large prompts can exceed practical model limits or increase cost. Expected Behavior: Transcript length should be bounded or chunked. Probable Root Cause: No explicit length validation exists. Recommended Action: Add configurable transcript size/token limit. Severity: Medium Priority: Medium Related Requirement: REQ-082;REQ-091
